changelog: - **The Inspector keeps its place when Detailed settings opens.** Opening Detailed settings makes the panel tall enough to scroll, and the scrollbar took its width from the content, so the Delete button, the fields and the relation rows moved left and narrowed by that width, and moved back when the section closed. The panel now reserves the scrollbar's room whether or not it scrolls, so nothing moves when the section opens or closes. The phone's read-only sheet is unchanged.
